reason: No release history exists in this repository: 0 git tags, 0 GitHub Releases, no CHANGELOG/release-notes file anywhere. The only version string is build.gradle's `version = '0.0.1-SNAPSHOT'`, which is the untouched Spring Boot scaffold default from the initial commit and has never been bumped, so there is no increment pattern to follow. .gitlab-ci.yml builds and deploys purely on branch pushes (main/develop) and never reacts to tags, so a tag would trigger nothing. Establishing a first-ever versioning/tagging convention is a human decision, so nothing was created.
